name: naija-childhood-api
description: NestJS backend for Naija Childhood: accounts, scores, leaderboards, daily challenges, remote config.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test: npm run build && export DATABASE_URL=${TEST_DATABASE_URL:-'postgresql://naija@localhost:54329/naija_childhood_test?host=/tmp'} JWT_SECRET=test-secret-test-secret-test-secret NODE_ENV=test && prisma migrate deploy >/dev/null && node --test --test-concurrency=1 dist/test/
